note: 2024/25 season (published 2026). Revenue and net result are sourced for all 11 clubs (SportsPro / matchdayfinance compilations of audited accounts). Audited total wage bills are sourced for Man City (£408m), Arsenal (£346.8m), Chelsea (£585m), Liverpool (~£428m) and Everton (~£145.6m, 74% of turnover); the other six are carry-forward estimates pending each club's filing (flagged wage_estimated:true). Revenue splits are prior-year proportions scaled to new revenue (estimated). This is the latest COMPLETE audited season — 2025/26 accounts do not exist yet (that season ended May 2026; accounts file ~2027).
